messages:
Sam: Quick heads-up — ArgosCorp wants a POC next week. Main asks: SSO (SAML + OIDC), SCIM provisioning (bulk + delta), RBAC mapping to Okta groups, domain ownership verification. They also need the security questionnaire answered and a rough Hosted vs Dedicated cost delta for provisioning scale (~200k users). Can SE + security triage?

Jordan: @Sam I can take the SE side. Do they need real-time group sync or nightly delta? Any constraints on IP allowlist / private connectivity for the POC?

Sam: They said near-real-time group sync (~5m lag OK). Prefer non-prod isolation (no prod creds). Asked if we can do a private tunnel or a dedicated non-prod pod.

Nina: I can take the sec questionnaire. Need IdP metadata (SAML XML / OIDC discovery URL), SCIM base URL, expected provisioning rates, audit-log retention, and KMS/HSM preference. Also legal asks about data residency and subprocessors.

Mike: SCIM infra notes:
- Default rate limit: 10 req/s per org, burst allowed. Can raise to 100 req/s on Dedicated.
- SCIM supports bulk create (POST /Users with array) + deltas via /Users?filter=meta.lastModified>...
- Mapped attributes: externalId, userName, name.familyName, name.givenName, emails[type=work].value, groups (Memberships).

Example curl + minimal payload:
```
curl -X POST "https://scim.redwood.ai/v2/Users" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"userName":"jane.doe@example.com","name":{"givenName":"Jane","familyName":"Doe"},"externalId":"12345","emails":[{"value":"jane.doe@example.com","type":"work"}] }'
```

Jordan: For POC I recommend Dedicated non-prod pod (isolated compute, higher SCIM rps). Hosted with IP allowlist + ephemeral creds is possible but may be flaky for large bulks. For 200k users and frequent group updates, Dedicated estimate: ~2x cost vs standard hosted throughput — ballpark $12k-$18k/mo for POC sizing (depends on GPU). I'll produce a cost/options sheet.

Sam: They asked about domain verification flow (proof of example-corp.com across 3 tenants). Do we support TXT + file verification and delegated subdomain verification?

Mike: Domain verification options:
- TXT DNS record (preferred)
- Upload verification file to host root
- Delegated tenant model supports wildcard subdomain verification + per-tenant claim binding
We require primary domain verification before SCIM provisioning to avoid account takeover risk.

Nina: Questionnaire sections we'll answer:
1) Authentication: SAML 2.0, OIDC, IdP/SP flows.
2) Provisioning: SCIM 2.0 compliance, rate limits, retry/backoff, delta sync.
3) RBAC: Okta groups -> Redwood roles, least-privilege mapping, role inheritance.
4) Data protection: at-rest AES-256, TLS 1.2+, KMS integration (customer-managed on Private), audit logs retention (90d default, extensible).
5) Network controls: VPC peering / PrivateLink on Dedicated/Private; IP allowlist for Hosted.

sec-bot: Security docs uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/SOC2_report_2025.pdf and https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/pen-test-summary-2024.pdf :lock:

Jordan: POC runbook proposal:
- Day 0: exchange IdP metadata + SCIM test creds (non-prod)
- Day 1: deploy Dedicated non-prod pod, provision 10k test users via bulk to validate mapping
- Day 2: scale to 100k, validate delta sync and group mappings
- Day 3: run RBAC regression tests and domain verification
Confirm whether ArgosCorp will provide a test Okta org or should we create a staging org.

Sam: I'll ask ArgosCorp to spin up a staging Okta tenant. If not, we'll create a staging org and share creds. They also want pricing commitment options after the POC — need a one-pager with Hosted POC cost, Dedicated POC cost, SLA delta, and upgrade path to Dedicated/Private.

Mike: Gotcha: SCIM bulk creates may return 207 Multi-Status for mixed results. Ensure client handles per-item errors. We mask emails in logs; full PII never logged.

Nina: I'll draft questionnaire answers and upload by EOD. For data residency confirm region (us-east vs eu-west). If EU, we need EU-hosted nodes or Private deployment.

Jordan: I'll assemble the POC runbook and cost sheet. Tagging @Mike for SCIM test creds & scripts and @Nina for questionnaire draft.

Sam: Action items: Sam to get IdP metadata and confirm staging Okta; Jordan builds POC runbook & cost sheet; Mike provides SCIM test creds & sample scripts; Nina completes security questionnaire. Target: POC kickoff scheduled by next Tue. :calendar:

Nina: ACK. I'll drop questionnaire link in thread when done.

Sam: Perfect — will loop in AE legal if any residency showstoppers. :thumbsup:
